preconditions.description: The number of elements in permutation p is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The length of the permutation p is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p)
preconditions.description: Each element in permutation p is between 1 and n inclusive.
All elements in permutation p are distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(q) == n and len(set(q)) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in q) and all(q[q[i-1]-1] == p[i-1] for i in range(1, n+1)))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no valid permutation q exists, or a permutation q of length n with distinct elements between 1 and n such that q[q[i-1]-1] = p[i-1] for each i from 1 to n.
